notes.title: First free expansion of Parkour Labs now in development
notes.content: After 5 months of work, I have prepared an update that will expand the game quite a lot, it will be released this Christmas, the game will have many new levels, and we will take the opportunity to request the verified on Steam Deck, apart from the porting to Unreal Engine 5, as always, thank you very much for playing Parkour Labs and the game will continue to have free expansions.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content: Fixed a performance error on Steam Deck and a Crash on startup if there isn't internet connection, sorry, i Will update again as soon as possible

notes.title: MEGA UPDATE: Parkour Labs NOW in Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
Now you can Play Parkour Labs on the official port on Unreal Engine 5, why Unreal Engine 5? Easy, better platform support, consoles, phones, etc

FEATURES:
- Better Jumps when you are failing
- Improvement Controls

BUGFIXES:
- Tiny bugs in the menus 


In a future, i will upload an update with a better difficult curve.

Thanks for all and no forget to leave a positive review on Steam

SoyKhaler

notes.title: Parkour Labs BIG UPDATE: Remind your level and Sensitivity
notes.content: The community had asked me to add a system to remind you of the levels you had already completed, and a system to change the sensitivity on the mouse and gamepad. After a week of hard work, here it is. In less than two weeks, you will have another update fixing the difficulty curve of certain levels. In short, we are going to improve the order in which the levels increase in difficulty. Thank you very much for being there, and if you are enjoying Parkour Labs, don't forget to leave a positive review on the Steam page. It helps us a lot.

notes.title: Funnier with counters! (time and death counters added)
notes.content:
[h1]The community was asking for it.[/h1]

[b]The community kept asking for a timer and death counter for Parkour Labs. A week after the launch, here you have it. This will be the first of many updates! Enjoy![/b]

notes.content:

Thank you and enjoy the game!
